title: The synthetic readers page: the scoreboard as tiles, a card per reader
summary: sherpa@'s S5 and S9, the designer's part of the synthetic readers pass: the scoreboard as five tiles and a bar, who waits on what as bars, and each invented reader as a card (who, where they came from, what lost them most, their findings). The SYNTHETIC line stays on top, as one line.

steps.label: Mock-up: tiles and cards
steps.note: Five tiles (open, accepted, later, done, verified) counted live from synthetic@'s findings.json, a bar of the same, waiting by owner as bars; then one card per reader, each marked SYNTHETIC, with initials and no face.

notes: S9: the scoreboard's numbers in sentences become five tiles and one bar; the colours are the brand's status colours.
S5: each persona was a paragraph; now a card: who, where they came from, their latest read if any, what lost them most (their most severe finding) and every finding they raised, as chips.
S10 kept as security@ asked: one SYNTHETIC line on top, every name marked SYNTHETIC, no face (initials on a dashed tile).
Built from synthetic@'s own files (desks/synthetic/), so the page can render it the same way: synthetic@ keeps the words, dev@ the two blocks.
